Hopping Leap Th e skyelarx pup can jump up to 10 ft. horizontally

Feigning Death (1/Day) Trigger: A creature the omaterssum joey 
can see moves within 5 ft. of it. Response - Wisdom Saving Th row:
DC 10, the omaterssum joey. Success: Th e omaterssum joey falls 
to the floor feigning death. Other creatures will think the joey is 
dead unless they make a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Perception 
or Survival) check. Critical Failure: Th e stress of the confrontation 
and its instinctual need to fake its own death overwhelms it and 
the omaterssum joey's heart gives out, and it dies.
Curling Tail Th e omaterssum joey can use its long prehensile tail 
to grip objects as if it is a hand, and it can hold its body weight 
when hanging from it.
Nascent Fore Blades Melee Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one 
target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage.
Skittish Survival Th e vinnirex pup can take a Dash or Disengage 
Action on each of its turns.
Jittery Jettison Trigger: When an enemy the wrakis larva can see 
makes a melee attack roll against it, while it underwater and 
before damage is dealt. Response - Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 10, 
the triggering creature. Failure: Th e attack misses instead and 
the wrakis larva swims backwards 5 ft. if there is free space.
Spawned in the thick silty waters of the Fenlands and the pitch black subterranean lakes within the Umbrawells, the wrakis larva 
spend their fi rst season of life voraciously hunting fi sh to grow quickly. After a few seasons of moulting, their limbs grow longer and 
more dense as they eventually crawl out of their nascent waters to hunt abroad.
Raised in communal nests within the highest peaks or forest canopies, the skyelarx pup knows only a life of joy and comfort for the 
fi rst few weeks of its life among its nest kin. It is only when its limbs grow strong enough to fly does it experience true terror as its 
parents push them from their home and hope that their young can survive their fi rst flight.
Unfortunately now a rarer sight in the waning days of the omaterssum that live on Sol'Kesh, the joey is a quick footed, curious little 
scoundrel, one that the mother omaterssum needs to keep an eye on all times or shove into her pouch for safe keeping. As a rather 
intelligent omnivore, the young possum will attempt to eat anything smaller than it, which may lead to dangerous encounters
Roaming in packs of a dozen of the small rambunctious little pups, they howl and bark incessantly as they play along the shore under 
the watchful eye of their adult guardians. When one strays from their kin for too long and loses them, its primal instinct kicks in to 
stay quiet and hope to fi nd a new pack to call their own, even if its not of their own kind.
Pining for a Pack If the vinnirex pup has no allies within 
eyesight, it has Disadvantage on Saving Th rows against being 
Charmed, Animal Friendship, and on any checks made to resist 
Animal Handling.
Aquatic Stalker Th e vinnirex pup has Advantage on Dexterity 
(Stealth) checks made to hide while underwater and can hold its 
breath for 10 minutes without needing air.
Young Hunter Senses Th e skyelarx pup has Advantage on 
Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight and hearing.
Acute Senses Th e omaterssum joey has Advantage on Wisdom 
(Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Aquatic Infancy Th e wrakis larva can breathe only underwater.
